title: Take the tour
note: The guided tour of one permit, from the application to the public record. The tour only opens screens and points at controls; it never changes a record. Each step names the walkthrough step of the same story.

steps.title: Apply for a permit
steps.caption: The applicant starts here: pick the project you need a permit for. The form asks only the questions that project needs.

steps.title: Let the agent route the work
steps.caption: The intake agent reads each new application and routes it to the right queue. It never decides: a person does that.

steps.title: Clear a case for review
steps.caption: The steward assistant prepares a recommendation; the Data Steward records the decision. The parcel link and the identity link must both be cleared before a reviewer may approve.

steps.title: Decide a case
steps.caption: The Review queue holds the cases with the reviewer and the recommendation of each one. Open a case, run the application checks, record the decision with its reason, then issue the permit.

steps.title: Check the record of the decision
steps.caption: Every action is recorded. Filter the log for the recorded permit decision and open its details.

steps.title: See the city at a glance
steps.caption: The City view: the counts, the map, and the definition printed beside each figure.

steps.title: Look up permits as a resident
steps.caption: The public record shows the permit, the parcel and the outcome. It never shows a homeowner's name, documents or fees.
